title: Adding Spaces to a String
summary: Given a string and an array of indices, insert spaces into the string at the specified indices.
statement: Given a string and an array of indices, insert spaces into the string at the specified indices. For instance, with s = "EnjoyYourCoffee" and spaces = [5, 9], the result is "Enjoy Your Coffee".
constraints: spaces is strictly increasing and every index identifies a character before which a space is inserted.
The original characters retain their order.
Return the new string containing all requested spaces.
hints: Both the string positions and requested indices are already ordered.
Walk the string while advancing one pointer through spaces whenever it matches the current index.
Before appending s[i], append one space if spaces[j]==i, then increment j.
Every requested index is encountered once in order, so every insertion occurs at its exact boundary.
editorial: Every requested index is encountered once in order, so every insertion occurs at its exact boundary.

tests.explanation: Inserting before H, M, and L yields Leetcode Helps Me Learn.
The indices split the text into Enjoy, Your, and Coffee.
